name: proof-or-bluff-realdeal-cli
description: Headless Node CLI for the realDeal Compact contract. Drives every circuit end-to-end against a local Midnight stack (or pre-prod) using a seed-phrase wallet, so we can exercise the wiring without a browser. Shares the on-chain contract with the browser app at ../app/.
_versionNotes: PUBLIC-NETWORK MATRIX (Oct 2 2026, verified via Kapa + npm): midnight-js 4.1.1, wallet-sdk 1.2.0 single barrel (EXACT pin — npm latest resolves to 1.1.0), ledger-v8 8.1.2 (validated in the Foundation's Blockfrost runbook), compact-js 2.5.1, compact-runtime 0.16.0 for Compact 0.31.1. Local stack must be midnight-local-dev's node 1.0.0 / indexer-standalone 4.3.3 (api/v4) / proof-server 8.1.0. The previous split wallet-sdk-* pins (facade 3 / dust 3 / unshielded 2) were a full major behind what wallet-sdk 1.2.0 wraps and produced transactions the current node validated but never included. Do NOT follow midnight-js 5.x (ledger 9) until public networks run it. The ROOT package.json carries an `overrides` pin for ledger-v8 — midnight-js-protocol otherwise nests its own 8.1.0 copy and WASM `instanceof LedgerParameters` checks fail across the two copies (npm honours overrides only at the workspace root).
